collection.description: Two Heathens disagree about an old carving on the memorial post that nobody can name.

description_variants.description: Two Isolans disagree about an old carving on the memorial post that nobody can name.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: One of the carvings on the camp's memorial post is so old that nobody can remember who it stands for. (subject) thinks it is wrong to keep honoring someone without a name. (friend) thinks the carving is honor enough.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) asks every elder at the camp. Nobody knows. One remembers that her own grandmother used to touch that carving every morning, "so it must have been someone she loved." (subject) decides that is enough of a name. (subject.He/she) starts touching it every morning too.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) and (friend) agree, in the end, to disagree. The carving stays nameless. (friend) points out that one day, they will be someone's unnamed carving too, and that (friend.he/she) rather likes the idea of being loved without anybody needing to remember why. \(no effect\)
